title: skills + ADR-0029 D9.2: 'an extension can add but never remove' no longer holds for pluralLabel after PR #30459
body:
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

Filing gate: should-fix 2 of the contract review of PR #30459 (#30391), record 6658126879, together with the dev's `Skills-docs: follow-up` line. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3. ⛔ Serial after PR #30459 merges.

## What is now inexact

- `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (Object Extension Model, ~L349) says an extension "can add but never remove". After PR #30459, an extension that sets `label` without `pluralLabel` takes the base's `pluralLabel` off the served object. The sentence needs that one exception.
- ADR-0029 D9.2 has a rationale sentence saying `mergeObjectDefinitions` "has no expression for removal at all", which is now imprecise for `pluralLabel`. No decision moves. ⛔ ADR text is Tier H: the maintainer, or the reviewers routed for Tier H, decide whether that sentence gets an amendment note.

## Ask

- Fix the skill sentence.
- Raise the ADR note for Tier H review: amend it, or record that it stays as it is.

Reader: `domain:skills` (skill sentence); Tier H (ADR). Links: #30391, PR #30459.
